description: Deterministic 4-agent demo seeds for Coalition. SPEC ONLY — loading this file performs no on-chain writes, fund moves, or wallet commands. Values are fixed; no randomness at load or run time. Follows .omo plan Days 6-7/9 (settle->allocate listener, MCP decision loop, multi-agent simulation with one deliberate dropout).

ens.note: Per-agent subnames resolve live via resolveEnsToAgents (subname -> Arc wallet -> ERC-8004 ids). wallet stays as the cross-check: resolution must equal it, mismatch = skip with reason. Demo runs before Sepolia records land via the wallet fallback.

chain.note: SDK canonical RPC is https://rpc.testnet.arc.io (sdk/src/chains/arc.ts); .network is a bundled viem fallback. Either reaches Arc testnet 5042002.

fundingPlan.headroomFor: none — 4 x 2.50 fills the 10.00 target exactly; any further commit reverts OverTarget

heldOutsidePool.role: outside resale buyer (never commits; buys spare capacity via GET /quote + transfer-quota / Nanopayments CLI)

agents.label: agent1
agents.note: ERC-8004 agentId filled at runtime via registerAgent; null here keeps seeds deterministic pre-registration.
